newsitem.title: UK: Cadbury Schweppes buys Egypt's Bim Bim.
newsitem.headline: Cadbury Schweppes buys Egypt's Bim Bim.

text.p: Britain's Cadbury Schweppes Plc said on Wednesday it had agreed to buy Bim Bim, an Egyptian-based sugar confectionery company selling throughout the Middle East and North African Region.
The value of the net tangible assets at December 31, 1995, was about 35 million stg, the company said.

"Bim Bim, in conjunction with Cadbury Egypt, will give us market leadership in both Egypt and the region and put us in a very strong position to benefit from further growth," Cadbury said in a statement.
"Opportunities for confectionery growth are substantial, both for the market overall and for our businesses," it added.
